name: Knockdown Shot [Psionic]
body:
You are capable of knocking down your enemies by psionically empowering your attacks.

Prerequisites: Dex 15, Point-Blank Shot, Psionic Shot

Benefit: You can expend your psionic focus and make a single ranged attack as a standard action. If your attack hits, it deals damage normally and the target must make a Reflex save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or be knocked prone.
